scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “An explicit power saving for the exact discrete Fourier transform” (preprints/An-explicit-power-saving-for-the-exact-discrete-Fourier-transform-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 130 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 670d0115ea2553e6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a single deterministic algorithm which, for every positive integer n and every x ∈ Cn, computes Fnx exactly. In the model above, including scalar preparation, schedule construction, and index work, its running time is O  n(log n)θ (log log n)4−θ  (1.2) as n → ∞. It suffices to supply the specified root ζD∗ for an explicitly computable integer D∗ < 1024n3.
